# BiologicallyPlausibleCreditAssignment

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A credit assignment mechanism that assigns error responsibility to neurons using only local, forward-propagated signals and noise correlations. Critical for implementing scalable learning in TCC/iNEST architectures that lack global gradient access.
